[Task index](core.md) · [Assets](assets.md) · [Headless captures](testing.md)

Get the host Canvas with `try ctx.requireCanvas()`, then clear/draw in call
order. It is a borrowed CPU raster target; do not deinit it. Canvas.init is
for a separately owned canvas, such as a test target. Drawing does not imply
GPU rasterization. See the [render contract](../guides/rendering.md) for alpha,
integer coordinates, camera, text glyphs and presenter behavior.

| Source-local name in a signature | Public game import |

| Color / Vec2 | `up.core.Color` / `up.core.Vec2` |
| Image / atlas_mod.Atlas | [`up.assets.Image` / `up.assets.Atlas`](assets.md) |

## Offscreen recipe

This complete function owns both targets and composes a nearest-scaled surface.
The pixel check runs on native and Wasm; a RenderSurface's borrowed canvas must
not outlive the surface. New surfaces start transparent.

[Compiled source](../../examples/api_reference_recipes.zig#L38) (`offscreen`):

```zig
pub fn offscreen(allocator: std.mem.Allocator) !u64 {
    var surface = try up.graphics.RenderSurface.init(allocator, 4, 4);
    defer surface.deinit();
    surface.canvas().clear(up.core.Color.transparent);
    surface.canvas().fillRect(1, 1, 2, 2, up.core.Color.rgb(20, 180, 90));
    var canvas = try up.graphics.Canvas.init(allocator, 16, 16);
    defer canvas.deinit();
    canvas.clear(up.core.Color.black);
    try canvas.drawSurface(&surface, .{ .x = 0, .y = 0, .width = 16, .height = 16 });
    if (!std.meta.eql(canvas.get(8, 8).?, up.core.Color.rgb(20, 180, 90))) return error.UnexpectedSurfacePixel;
    return up.testSupport.canvasHash(canvas);
}
```


Surface draws require nonzero destination sizes at most maxInt(i32), otherwise
`InvalidSurfaceDrawSize`. Surface creation rejects invalid dimensions with
`InvalidRenderSurfaceSize`. Sampling a surface onto itself returns
`SurfaceSelfSampling`. Tint multiplies sampled RGBA before the current blend;
clips bound destination writes. Linear filtering preserves staged byte rounding
and uses bounded scratch without a per-draw heap allocation. It still costs CPU
time; [measured workloads](../guides/surface-composition-performance.md) are
not whole-game frame-rate guarantees.

`pushClip` returns the previous clip; pair it with `restoreClip(previous)`.
`setBlend` similarly returns the previous mode. These Canvas calls use saved
values, not the separate command-buffer push/pop interface.

`writePpmFile` and `writePngFile` are native filesystem helpers, not browser
save APIs. `writePng` accepts a caller-provided Writer. `attachTrace` borrows
a test-owned trace; detach it before destroying the trace. Trace capture may
allocate, while ordinary drawing does not retain an operation log.

### `up.graphics.Canvas.drawSurface`

[Source declaration](../../src/canvas.zig#L283).

Composites the latest pixels of an owned offscreen RenderSurface. The
source may not be the Canvas currently receiving the draw; doing so is
a feedback loop and returns `error.SurfaceSelfSampling`.

```zig
pub fn drawSurface(self: *Canvas, surface: *const RenderSurface, options: SurfaceDrawOptions) !void;
```

<a id="graphics-RenderSurface"></a>
## `up.graphics.RenderSurface`

[Source declaration](../../src/canvas.zig#L591).

Persistent, Peas-owned offscreen 2D surface. It owns a Canvas-sized pixel
buffer initialized to transparent black. Draw into `canvas()` with the
ordinary Canvas API, then compose it onto another Canvas with
`drawSurface`. There is no target stack or GPU-resource ownership exposed.

[`init`](#graphics-RenderSurface-init) · [`deinit`](#graphics-RenderSurface-deinit) · [`canvas`](#graphics-RenderSurface-canvas) · [`width`](#graphics-RenderSurface-width) · [`height`](#graphics-RenderSurface-height)

<a id="graphics-SurfaceDrawOptions"></a>
## `up.graphics.SurfaceDrawOptions`

[Source declaration](../../src/canvas.zig#L28).

Destination geometry and sampling for `Canvas.drawSurface`.
Width and height are explicit logical pixels; a zero size is rejected.

Fields, variants and defaults (methods follow):

```zig
struct {
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
    width: u32,
    height: u32,
    tint: Color = Color.white,
    filter: SurfaceFilter = .nearest,
}
```


<a id="graphics-SurfaceFilter"></a>
## `up.graphics.SurfaceFilter`

[Source declaration](../../src/canvas.zig#L24).

Sampling used when a RenderSurface is scaled during composition.
`nearest` is the default because it preserves pixel-art edges exactly.

Fields, variants and defaults (methods follow):

```zig
enum {
    nearest,
    linear,
}
```
